newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek brokers' market shares in March - SMEHA.
newsitem.headline: Greek brokers' market shares in March - SMEHA.

text.p: March trading volume at the Athens stock exchange reached 552.08 billion drachmas, down from 858.02 billion in February, the exchange's members association (SMEHA) said.

The monthly market share rankings showed Alpha Brokerage leading the bourse's 63 brokers with 8.5 percent of the business, followed by National Securities with 8.04 percent and Sigma Securities with 7.34 percent.
Cumulative first quarter trading volume reached 1.938 trillion drachmas compared to 3.97 trillion in the entire 1996.
First quarter cumulative rankings showed Alpha Brokerage ahead with 8.02 percent followed by Sigma Securities with 7.49 and National Securities with 6.24 percent. Devletoglou was fourth with 6.11.

SMEHA released the following data and market share rankings for March. The top 15 brokers shared 60 percent of the bourse's trading volume. The remainder went to the exchange's other 47 member brokers.
